Legend and Notes Assassin / Berserker / Lizardman Astaroth Cassandra Cervantes Ivy Kilik Maxi Mitsurugi Necrid Nightmare Raphael Seong Mi-na Sophitia Taki Talim Voldo Xianghua Yoshimitsu Yun-seong

Welcome one and all, as many of you know the effects in SC2 are ambiguous as hell and don't fully tell the story (effects) right, some even lie about what effect it has and others don't even tell you anything (Legendary Weapons) . I have taken the liberty to deeply uncover the mysteries of each weapon so before I start with the weapons here are effects you will be seeing, be careful as it may get confusing later on down the line so check these often.

This guide was previously published on Another Stage of History.

Legend and Notes

  • Console specific characters are excluded from the list.
  • Throws and Unblockable damage is dependent on your weapons attack, unlike SC3 and SC4.
  • As with all Soul series, higher attack number means higher damage dealt and higher defense number means higher damage taken. Example: Attacker with 100% damage weapon versus defender with 70% defense will mean that the attacker will generally do 100%*70% = 70% damage against the defender.
  • Defense Written as 100/(XXX) 100: Weak defense against single strikes. The first strike of an attack will do what is in the parenthesis any other hits resulting in a combo will do damage based on the outside, single hits do more damage than a comboed hit. Example: Xianghua's AAB with the No Name will do 84%,70%,70% against a Talim holding Wind Guide.
  • Attack Written as (1XX) 100/100: Strong single strikes. First hit will do more damage than the rest of a combo
  • Attack written as (SC1XX) 100/100: Meaning: Soul Charged single strikes do more damage. This is really only here cause it is said on the weapon for whatever reason...
Icon Name Explanation
Regen Life restores over time. I don't think I need to explain...
Sap Life drains over time. I don't think I need to explain...
XX% Shave Damage Penetrates opponents defense. XX% of the damage your attack would do will still go through against a defending opponent, this is useless against enemies wielding a weapon with Deblock on it (read below) .
Takes XX% Shave Damage Guard is vulnerable. XX% of your opponents attack will go through if you were blocking their attack, this does collective damage with XX% Shave Damage.
Drain Strike Lose life with any form of strikes. Attacking wildly and missing will have you losing life, since the game bases everything on percentages there is no accurate way to measure this.
Leach Strike Gain life from any form of strikes. Attacking wildly and missing will have you gain life, since the game bases everything on percentages there is no accurate way to measure this.
Drain Hit Dealing damage to an opponent also deals damage to you. Attacks that are blocked will not have you losing life.
Leach Hit Dealing damage to an opponent makes you gain life back. Attacks that are blocked will not have you gaining life.
Longer Reach Your weapon is longer... Weapons are truly longer, unlike SCIII where weapon models are enlarged.
Shorter Reach Your weapon is shorter... Weapons are truly shorter, unlike SCIII where weapon models are shrunken.
Deblock Unable to block attacks. Blocking defense become XX%. You will see that you can still execute the guard animation, but when struck the attack will go through as if you weren't blocking, if you happen to be blocking when hit you will be given a small defense boost to lighten the damage.
CSCd Constant Soul Charge damage. Soul Charge lasts longer and will continue to deal more damage till either you block, get hit, or it runs out. Your attacks are slower in execution unless noted about it.
Soul Charge Attack Speed Normal During Soul Charge, your attack speed becomes normal. This cancels the slow attack speed caused by Constant Soul Charge Damage.
Soul Charge Attack Speed Up During Soul Charge, your attack speed increased. Exactly as it says on the tin.
Soul Charge defense up Soul Charge increases defense. Usually when hit while Soul Charging/having Soul Charge in effect you would be dealt counter damage. With this effect, you will take less damage over the course of Soul Charge's lasting effect (how long it last if you didn't get hit) than you would from a regular hit. The Soul Charge animation must finish or you will be dealt counter damage.
Soul Charge Null Counter Soul Charge nulls forced counter damage Usually when hit while Soul Charging/having Soul Charge in effect you would be dealt counter damage. With this effect, you will take as much damage as you would from a regular hit. Even if you are struck during Soul Charge, you will take minimal damage.
Soul Charge Life Regain Regains life during charge animation The amount of time you go through during the Soul Charge animation will have you gain life for as long as you did it.
Soul Charge Life Drain Loses life during charge animation The amount of time you go through during the Soul Charge animation will have you lose life for as long as you did it, if you do a Soul Charge with low health you can lose the round.
Speed up Soul Charge Speeds up charge animation. Soul Charge animation finishes a lot quicker.
Funny Sound Weapon produces funny sound Each hit produces an irregular sound.
Notes Weapon have a noteworthy stat. Will be explained as needed.
